CommunityApplications.Profile: Freeman Notes — a self-hosted, offline-first, real-time collaborative notes PWA. Rich text notes, checklists, drawings (Excalidraw), image uploads with OCR search, document attachments, and multi-device sync via Yjs CRDT, all running on your own hardware. This repository hosts the Unraid Community Applications template for Freeman Notes. For support, please open an issue on GitHub.
CommunityApplications.DonateText: If Freeman Notes is useful to you, a coffee is always appreciated!
